item.title: DTN2026-28 - Anthropic, PBC Initial Public Offering on Nasdaq Global Select Market
item.ndaq:WhatYouNeedToKnow:
Anthropic, PBC - Class A common stock is expected to be listed and begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker symbol ANT on November 19, 2026.

Nasdaq requests that market data distributors update their databases to reflect this upcoming listing and display the symbol at their earliest opportunity.

item.title: DTN2026-27 - General Motors Company & General Motors Financial Company to Begin Listing and Trading on Nasdaq on November 17, 2026
item.ndaq:WhatYouNeedToKnow:
On November 17, 2026, General Motors Company (NYSE: GM) is expected to be listed and begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the same ticker symbol GM. General Motors Financial Company will transfer the listing of its $750 mil aggregate principal amount of 6.15% senior notes due 2035 (NYSE:GM/35B) to the Nasdaq Global Market under the new symbol GM35B.

Nasdaq requests that market data redistributors update their databases to reflect the new listing market for General Motors & GM Financial after market close on November 16, 2026, and maintain historical data for GM and GM/35B prior to transfer date.
